scope: Theorem 4.3 (Coordinate comparison) of the manuscript “The height-three chromatic overlap: an explicit filtration and its attachments” (preprints/The-height-three-chromatic-overlap-an-explicit-filtration-and-its-attachments-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 05577ee22db5cad1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 17-18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a natural P3 × GLr(Zp)-equivariant isomorphism Tm ≃ (Hr 3 )ind. 17 The map takes a compatible basis of generator lifts to zi = liml tp3l i,l . It identifies the relevant completed function algebras with their spectral norms on exhausted closed smaller balls. The assertion holds on the relative perfectoid site and remains valid after adjoining arbitrary profinite parameters.
